rows.paragraph: Devika knows the work when I ask her at her desk, but she is afraid of written tests and leaves half the paper blank.
Samar argues with his partner in pair work nearly every time. Alone he works steadily.
Lata is very shy and will not answer in front of the class, though her written work is good.
Gopal struggles with reading and is about two years behind the class. He follows well when a story is read to him.

rows.paragraph: Rhea reads far above her grade level and has finished every book on the class shelf.
Imran has not handed in homework for three weeks. In class he does the work without trouble.
Pooja missed two weeks of school in October and now freezes in tests, even on work she knew before.
Vikram has asthma and keeps an inhaler in his bag. He must not run in the dust.
Sana's mother works nights, so nobody can come to school meetings. The family cannot pay for the trip.
Harsh understands a new idea much faster when he can draw it. He loses the thread in long spoken explanations.
